source.name: Item file tarrabah
source.note: Derived: the weapon has no charge of its own; the Quantum time to empty counts from the first shot

catalyst.name: Ambitious Assassin, Tarrabah Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Reloading after scoring kills with Tarrabah overfills the magazine from reserves based on the number of Kills scored.
Tarrabah overfills the next magazine by 20% per kill scored, up to a maximum of 150% Base Magazine Capacity. Always rounds up.
Kill counter persists through stow.
